data.title: Simpleads vs Saleshandy: Purpose-Built Sourcing vs an Outreach Tool's Lead Finder
data.intro:
Saleshandy is primarily a cold-email outreach and sequencing platform — automated sequences, sender rotation, a unified inbox, deliverability tooling — with a newer Lead Finder bolted on as a separate, credit-metered product. Simpleads is built the other way around: sourcing and scoring is the entire product, not an add-on to an outreach tool.
That distinction matters for pricing and depth. Saleshandy's Lead Finder credits are a small bundled allotment on most plans, with heavier list-building requiring a separate $29-$199/month add-on or an upgrade tier. Simpleads' full pipeline — People, Company, Jobs, Scoring, Export — is the core product from the start.

data.title: Better sourcing, whatever you use to send.
data.content: Filter, score and export — no outreach tool required.
data.cta: Source Leads Without an Outreach Tool

items.a: For the sourcing piece, yes — Simpleads' full pipeline (People, Company, Jobs, Scoring, Export) is a purpose-built alternative to Saleshandy's add-on Lead Finder. Simpleads doesn't include email sequencing, which remains Saleshandy's core strength.

items.q: Does Saleshandy's Lead Finder include hiring-signal or scoring data?
items.a: No — Saleshandy's Lead Finder is a credit-metered contact database; it doesn't cross-reference job postings or score leads by relevance the way Simpleads does.

items.q: Can I use Simpleads and Saleshandy together?
items.a: Yes — many teams source and score leads in Simpleads, then load the resulting list into Saleshandy for sequencing and deliverability management.

items.q: Is Saleshandy's Lead Finder cheaper than Simpleads?
items.a: Saleshandy's Lead Finder starts at $24/month, but a functional outreach + Lead Finder setup often runs $83+/month once add-ons are included. Compare that against Simpleads' plan-based pricing for your specific lead volume.
